decisions.statement: A call saying no visit reads the most recent trace.
A visit is counted back from the most recent, which is visit one.
The answer names every visit kept by its time and its banking bag.
Each phase has its own time bracket.
The trace names the moves made and what the net-worth walk cost.
Each move a settle left unconfirmed is named under the round that left it.
A move named says how much of its source stack moved and how much room its target had.
A file with no trace refuses the call.
A visit past the ones kept refuses the call.

definition: the command giving back a timing trace from one of the addon's banking sessions
